_comment: Mutation testing — the QUALITY check that complements the CI coverage floor. Scoped to the money-critical modules on purpose: mutating the whole codebase would be far too slow, and these are where a surviving mutant (a bug the tests do not catch) matters most. Runs against the unit suite via jest. Not a per-push CI gate (too slow) — run manually / on a schedule. See ROADMAP 'Estándares de testing'.
_timeout_comment: El jest-runner reinicia workers por mutante; el arranque (setupFiles + carga del grafo de models) puede exceder el timeout por defecto (5s) y marcar mutantes como timeout en vez de killed. 30s da holgura para que los tests corran y mueran limpio por aserción.
